headline: Nam A Bank Appears in Southeast Asia's Top 10 Listed Banks for the First Time
summary: Nam A Bank has been included for the first time in S&P Global Market Intelligence's list of the 50 largest listed banks in Southeast Asia, ranking 10th regionally. The ranking uses fiscal year 2025 data.
why: S&P Global Market Intelligence ranks listed banks by financial performance, which is a reference point for investors comparing regional lenders. Nam A Bank is a Vietnamese commercial bank.
